args: const fs=require("fs"),cp=require("child_process"),p=process.argv[1];let count=0;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(p)){if(f.endsWith(".mjs")){cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,["--check",p+"/"+f]);count++}if(f.endsWith(".mjs")||f.endsWith(".md")){const s=fs.readFileSync(p+"/"+f,"utf8");if(/\n\s*\n$/.test(s)||/[ \t]+$/m.test(s))throw Error("Evidence whitespace "+f)}}console.log(JSON.stringify({syntaxFiles:count,evidenceWhitespacePassed:true}));
